name: Louisiana Revised Statutes 51:2370.30 broadband reporting requirements
known_limitations: The statute establishes reporting duties, including annual reporting on the percentage of locations with access that actually subscribe and average subscriptions. It is a reporting requirement, not a project return, and it supplies no current Starlink installation or subscription numerator, cohort, observation period, or method.
automation_notes: Use the statutory adoption fields to define a future qualifying artifact; do not treat the legal duty or an access report as the observed project result.
